qa_pairs.question: What options are available to prevent an Abaqus job from waiting indefinitely for a license on an Alliance cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: There are two main options to prevent an Abaqus job from waiting indefinitely for a license. Firstly, you can terminate a job immediately if licenses aren't available by creating an `abaqus_v6.env` file in your submit directory containing the line `lmlicensequeuing=OFF`. Secondly, you can specify a finite wait time by adding `lmhanglimit=1` (or another number in minutes) to the `abaqus_v6.env` file. If sufficient licenses don't become available within the specified time, the job will be dequeued and terminated by Slurm.
